outcome: Changes in uterine dimensions (longitudinal, anteroposterior, transverse diameters, volume)
finding: Uterine involution in the early puerperium is influenced by parity, mode of delivery, breastfeeding, and birth weight, with cesarean section being associated with smaller uterine volume on day 2 postpartum.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with smaller uterine volume on day 2 postpartum compared to vaginal delivery.
